about: Mob motion for Minecraft mode, tuned on the Mob Farm hook. A preset is applied to one or more mobs; `phase` gives each mob's frame offset in the order they are listed (stagger: never two mobs on the same frame). keys: at = frame (or "arrive" = when a walk at `walkSpeed` blocks/frame reaches its point); where = origin (the mob's spot) | to (the `to` param, one point per mob or one for all) | target (the `target` id's spot) | above (origin + [0, drop, 0]) | back (origin moved `recoil` blocks away from `to`) | [dx,dy,dz]; facing = number (Minecraft yaw: 0 +z, -90 +x, 90 -x, 180 -z) | "target" | "to" | "keep" (default) with sway = +-degrees; look = "target" (its head) | null | "keep". Idle (breathing, head looks) is drawn by the renderer at all times: mobs are never frozen. Expanded by src/director/minecraft/presets.ts.

spawn_drop.use: mobs spawn: drop in from above, squash-land with a puff, eyes snap on
spawn_drop.followThrough: land overshoots to scale 1.18 then settles to 1 in 4 frames
spawn_drop.notes: Land the first mob ON its word (monsters / spawn); the others follow on the phase offsets.

eyes_snap.use: glowing eyes open in the dark (tease optional)

stagger_wander.use: mobs wander aimlessly: each walks to its own `to` point, start times staggered, facing sways
stagger_wander.notes: Cross the mobs' paths in depth (one near, one far) so the frame never shows a line-up.

wall_bump.use: a mob walks into a wall and recoils (comedy beat: they are dumb in the dark)
wall_bump.notes: The recoil frames are cubicOut (snap back, slow stop).

turn_to_look.use: a mob notices the target: head first, body 2 frames later

menace_approach.use: mobs close in on the target slowly, swaying (zombie shuffle), stopping short
menace_approach.notes: Sway: facing alternates +-25 deg every 6 frames while walking (r8 note: straight walks read as robots).

bow_draw_fire.use: a skeleton turns, draws, fires an arrow that streaks and sticks at `to`

params.to: where the arrow sticks (beside the target, never in the face)

bow_draw_fire.anticipation: turn to the target with backOut (2 frames), draw aim 0.2 -> 1 over 5 frames cubicOut, hold 1
bow_draw_fire.followThrough: release snaps aim to 0.3 (expoOut, 2 frames), redraws to 0.8 by +14
bow_draw_fire.easing: turn backOut, draw cubicOut, release expoOut
